Command.Statement: WITH MEMBER [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[Resp and Circ] AS Aggregate({[ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[DIAGNOSES].[RESPIRATORY], [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[DIAGNOSES].[CIRCULATORY]}) MEMBER [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[Resp and J06] AS Aggregate({[ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[DIAGNOSES].[RESPIRATORY], [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[DIAGNOSES].[RESPIRATORY].[UPPER_RESPIRATORY_INFECTIONS].[J06]}) MEMBER [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[Not recorded and Thyroid] AS Aggregate({[ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[DIAGNOSES].[NOT_RECORDED], [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[DIAGNOSES].[ENDOCRINE_AND_METABOLIC].[THYROID_DISORDERS]}) SELECT {[Measures].[ZCLVISNO], [Measures].[ZCLCHRG]} ON 0, {[ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[Resp and Circ], [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[Resp and J06], [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[Not recorded and Thyroid], [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[DIAGNOSES].[RESPIRATORY], [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[DIAGNOSES].[CIRCULATORY]} ON 1 FROM [ZCLVISIT]
